blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Я получаю настоящее удовольствие, ___ (помогать) нетрудоспособным людям.
exercises.prompt: I really enjoy helping disabled people.
exercises.why: An imperfective деепричастие: -я / -а, an action at the same time. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: ___ (перенервничать), Мария провалила собеседование при приёме на работу.
exercises.prompt: Mary's nerves caused her to mess up her job interview.
exercises.why: A perfective деепричастие: -в / -вшись, an action done first. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).

exercises.q: Я чуть не убился, ___ (пытаться) это сделать.
exercises.prompt: I nearly killed myself doing that.
exercises.why: An imperfective деепричастие: -я / -а, an action at the same time. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
